intro: Algeria has about 47 million people, most living near the coast.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Algerians are of Arab and Amazigh descent; Kabyle, Chaoui and Tuareg are Amazigh groups. Arabic and Tamazight are official, and French is widely spoken. Almost everyone is Sunni Muslim.
The population is young, and many Algerians live in France.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Algiers, the 'White City', is the capital; Oran and Constantine are other big cities.
